title: Smoky turkey and peppers with herby rice

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or plain staple: rice, oil, turkey mince, fresh vegetables, natural yoghurt, spices and parsley.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan, a saucepan and a sieve, and the techniques are simple boiling and frying.

works.reason: 300g rice, 500g turkey and 3 peppers suit four, the spicing is enough and the boiling and frying times are sound.

honest_times.reason: About 10 minutes of chopping plus roughly 15 minutes of browning and frying fits 25 minutes prep, and the rice boils in the 15 minutes cook.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, nothing unlisted appears, and each name matches its id.

seasonal_feel.reason: Three peppers fried with cherry tomatoes make a bright, quick July dinner with the peppers at its heart.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a balanced family dinner of lean protein, plenty of vegetables, rice and yoghurt.
